documents.title: APS 6012 - Responsible Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI)
documents.quality_note: System-wide administrative policy covering academic integrity, data protection, transparency and review of AI output.

documents.unit: Boulder Faculty Assembly and Center for Teaching & Learning
documents.title: Generative Artificial Intelligence Syllabus Guidance
documents.quality_note: Four levels of permitted AI use with sample syllabus language; marked DRAFT and a living document, and says CU Boulder has no campus-wide student AI rule.

documents.title: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Data Security Guidelines
documents.quality_note: Rules on what data may go into AI tools (approved for Public data only); about data security, not teaching.

notes: No school-level (College of Engineering and Applied Science) or computing-unit (CS, Information Science, ATLAS) AI policy found by search; CS course sites exist but course syllabi are deferred. Not collected: the CTL AI Syllabus Statements page (a short page that only links the guidance PDF), the Honor Code page (no AI text), and APS 6012 draft 4 (superseded by the final).
